system.description:
Scout-Nin Keyword: Specialized

While you are under the effects of a condition, jutsu, or trait that would last longer beyond the end of your turn, you can spend a superiority die. Immediately make an additional saving throw or skill check to resist the condition, jutsu or trait vs its original DC, adding the result of your superiority die to your saving throw or skill check. If it does not have a DC to resist, the DC becomes 10 + Triggering creatures or environmental effects level/rank (D-Rank: 5, C-Rank: 7, B-Rank: 9, A-Rank: 11, S-Rank: 13)..
